prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production monster sprite animation sheet for the existing portrait action RPG.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is STYLE/LAYOUT reference ONLY: match crisp finely detailed high-resolution pixel illustrated fantasy sprites, dark ink outlines, 3/4 overhead RPG camera, shading and level of detail; never copy its wolf subject. Image2 is SUBJECT CONCEPT reference only, its small matching creature. Produce a brand-new single-species sheet.
OUTPUT: genuinely transparent RGBA, no matte, no checkerboard, no background, no floor, no shadow oval. Square 2048x2048 or larger native pixels. Exactly25 separate full-body monster silhouettes in a perfectly regular5 columns x5rows invisible grid. Each cell same dimensions and clear padding; do not touch adjacent poses or canvas edge. No labels, text, frame borders, UI, grid lines, glow background, extra monsters or scenery.
DIRECTIONS by ROW top-to-bottom: row1 front facing screen/down(south);row2 front-right three-quarter(southeast);row3 right profile(east);row4 back-right three-quarter(northeast);row5 back facing screen/up(north). Actually turn anatomy, faces and bodies in each row; do not repeat front view.
ACTIONS by COLUMN left-to-right:1 walkA planted leftfoot;2 walkB visibly alternating limbs;3 attack windup;4 attack contact with distinct forward action;5 dead flattened body lying on ground. Keep each direction's anatomical body scale unchanged across actions. All poses independently isolated. Feet or grounded contact point aligned near cell bottom; full anatomy, no clipping. This is ONE creature species repeated25 times for animation, not a monster catalog. 
SUBJECT: A dangerous eight-legged forest hunting spider, broad moss-green/brown hairy abdomen, amber eyes, red-tipped fang mandibles, two clear body sections and eight long angular legs. Match spider archetype in reference encyclopaedia. Distinct from wolves and humanoids. Attack windup pulls front legs back and raises fangs; attack contact lunges forward with spread fangs; death curled-in eight legs.
